name: io.github.thevrus/marklayer
title: MarkLayer
description: Work visual annotations on a live webpage: watch, acknowledge, resolve, reply, or leave your own.

packageArguments.name: --room
packageArguments.description: MarkLayer room to join at startup: a share URL (https://marklayer.app/s/abc123) or a bare room id. Omit it and the agent calls marklayer_connect_room instead.

packageArguments.name: --api-base
packageArguments.description: Override the MarkLayer worker base URL. Defaults to https://marklayer.app; useful against a local dev worker.

packageArguments.name: --agent
packageArguments.description: Name shown to the humans in the room for this agent. Defaults to claude-code.

packageArguments.name: --readonly
packageArguments.description: Read and watch only: every tool that changes the room is refused, even on a link that allows edits.

environmentVariables.name: MARKLAYER_ROOM
environmentVariables.description: Same as --room: the share URL or room id to join at startup.

environmentVariables.name: MARKLAYER_API_BASE
environmentVariables.description: Override the MarkLayer worker base URL. Defaults to https://marklayer.app; useful against a local dev worker.

environmentVariables.name: MARKLAYER_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: Name shown to the humans in the room for this agent. Defaults to claude-code.

environmentVariables.name: MARKLAYER_READONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 for the same as --readonly.

environmentVariables.name: MARKLAYER_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Password for a protected room. Environment only, so it stays out of the process list.
